svg.aria-label: Growth ladder: seed, sprout, leaf, bud, bloom. Twenty units of one stage merge into one unit of the next; bloom takes 1.6 billion food tokens.

svg.text: Every 10,000 tokens plants a seed. Twenty of a kind grow into the next stage.

svg.text: 10,000 × 20⁴ = 1,600,000,000 food tokens to bloom — the next feeding starts a new generation.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Food = input + output + cache writes. Cache reads are counted but never eaten.
